description: Get the full content of a specific report, or the latest report for a target if report_id is omitted.

domain.description: Convenience alias for target_id: an active target's domain, resolved server-side.

report_id.description: Report ID. Omit for the latest report.

target_id.description: Which target to read. Optional when the key can act on a single target; required otherwise.

name: get_report
